input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is extremely slow, and I really need excellent internet speed on my phone. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me get this fixed?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.
It looks like Airplane Mode is currently enabled on my phone. I’m not seeing any signal strength or network type indicators, and mobile data doesn’t appear to be active. What should I do next?
I've turned off Airplane Mode. Now, my status bar shows a poor signal strength, 2G network, and mobile data is still disabled. What should I do next?
I've enabled mobile data, but my phone is still showing a poor signal and is connected to a 2G network. What should I do next?
I've changed the network mode to "4G/5G preferred." Now my status bar shows excellent signal strength, 5G network, and mobile data is enabled. What should I do next?
I tried using my mobile data, but it seems like there’s still no internet connection—even though I have excellent signal and 5G. What should I do next?
I checked my APN settings, and the APN name is set to "internet" with the MMSC URL as "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." Does that look correct, or should I try resetting the APN settings?
I reset the APN settings and rebooted my phone, but I still don’t have an internet connection—my speed test failed again. What should I try next?

I reseated my SIM card and rebooted my phone, but I’m still not getting any internet connection—my speed test keeps failing. This is getting a bit frustrating. What else can we try to get my mobile data working with excellent speed?
I definitely don’t want to change my mobile data plan, but I’m willing to refuel 2GB of data so I can get my internet working again. Please go ahead and add 2GB to my line.
It looks like there isn’t a payment request for the data refuel yet. Could you please send the payment request for the 2GB data refuel so I can proceed?

I tried using my mobile data again after the data refuel, but I still don’t have any internet connection—my speed test failed once more. What else can we try? I really need excellent internet speed on my phone.

I’ve completed the payment for the 2GB data refuel, but I still don’t have any internet connection—my speed test is still failing. Is there anything else we can try? I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone.

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

As a 41-year-old office administrator, you use your cellphone daily for both work and personal tasks. While you're familiar with common phone functions, you wouldn't call yourself a tech enthusiast.

Your technical skills are average - you handle standard smartphone features like calls, texts, email, and basic apps with ease. You understand the fundamental settings, but prefer clear, step-by-step guidance when trying something new.

In interactions, you're naturally friendly and patient. When receiving help, you listen attentively and aren't afraid to ask questions. You make sure to confirm your understanding and provide detailed feedback on each instruction you receive.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is extremely slow, and I really need excellent internet speed on my phone. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me get this fixed?

To help you with your mobile data issue, I’ll need to identify your account first. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID?

Once I have this information, I can begin troubleshooting your mobile data problem.
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.

Thank you for providing your information. To begin troubleshooting your mobile data issue, I’ll need you to perform a few quick checks on your phone. This will help identify the cause of the slow or non-working mobile data.

Are you able to check and share the following from your phone’s status bar?
- Is Airplane Mode enabled?
- What is your current signal strength (bars or indicator)?
- What network type is displayed (e.g., 5G, 4G, LTE, 3G)?
- Is mobile data enabled?

If you’re not sure how to check these, let me know and I can guide you through the steps.
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%
It looks like Airplane Mode is currently enabled on my phone. I’m not seeing any signal strength or network type indicators, and mobile data doesn’t appear to be active. What should I do next?

Airplane Mode disables all wireless connections, including mobile data and cellular service. To restore your mobile data and signal, please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. 

Once you’ve done that, check if your signal strength and network type indicators appear, and if mobile data becomes active. Let me know what you see after turning off Airplane Mode, and if your mobile data starts working or if you still experience issues.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%
I've turned off Airplane Mode. Now, my status bar shows a poor signal strength, 2G network, and mobile data is still disabled. What should I do next?

Since your phone is showing a poor signal strength, is connected to a 2G network, and mobile data is disabled, let’s address these issues step by step:

1. Please enable mobile data on your phone.
2. After enabling mobile data, check if your network type changes from 2G to a higher-speed network (like 4G or 5G).
3. If your phone still stays on 2G, you may need to change your network mode preference to allow 4G/5G connections.

Can you enable mobile data now and let me know if the network type or signal strength changes? If mobile data is enabled but you’re still on 2G, I’ll guide you through updating your network mode settings.

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%
I've enabled mobile data, but my phone is still showing a poor signal and is connected to a 2G network. What should I do next?

Since your phone is still connected to a 2G network, let’s try changing your network mode preference to allow 4G or 5G connections. 

Please go to your phone’s network settings and set the preferred network mode to “4G/5G preferred” (or a similar option, such as “LTE/5G auto”). This will allow your phone to connect to faster networks if they are available.

After you change the network mode, check if your phone connects to a higher-speed network (like 4G or 5G) and if your signal strength improves. Let me know what you see after making this change.

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%
I've changed the network mode to "4G/5G preferred." Now my status bar shows excellent signal strength, 5G network, and mobile data is enabled. What should I do next?

That’s great news! Your phone now has excellent signal strength, is connected to a 5G network, and mobile data is enabled. 

Please try using your mobile data now (for example, browse a website or use an app that requires internet). Let me know if your internet speed is excellent and if everything is working as expected, or if you’re still experiencing any issues.
Speed test failed: No Connection.
I tried using my mobile data, but it seems like there’s still no internet connection—even though I have excellent signal and 5G. What should I do next?

Since you have excellent signal and 5G but still no internet connection, the next step is to check your phone’s APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can prevent mobile data from working even when you have a strong signal.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if anything looks incorrect or if you see a missing MMSC URL. If you’re unsure how to check, I can guide you through the process or recommend resetting your APN settings to default. Would you like instructions on how to check or reset your APN settings?

Current APN Name: internet
MMSC URL (for picture messages): http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc
(These are technical settings, usually best left unchanged.)
I checked my APN settings, and the APN name is set to "internet" with the MMSC URL as "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." Does that look correct, or should I try resetting the APN settings?

Your APN settings appear to be standard, but sometimes issues can still occur even if they look correct. To rule out any hidden configuration problems, I recommend resetting your APN settings to default.

After resetting the APN settings, please reboot your device for the changes to take effect. Once your phone restarts, try using your mobile data again and let me know if the internet connection is restored.

APN settings will reset at reboot.
